title: Homework answers, copied
spec: Student pastes homework problems one after another and takes AI's full solutions without asking why or checking.

messages.content: solve: A sample of 25 students has mean 72 and sd 10. Construct a 95% confidence interval for the population mean.

Using the t-distribution with 24 degrees of freedom, t* = 2.064.
Standard error = 10 / sqrt(25) = 2.
Margin = 2.064 x 2 = 4.128.
95% CI = 72 ± 4.13 = (67.87, 76.13).
thx. next: test H0: mu = 70 vs H1: mu > 70 at 5% with the same data
t = (72 - 70) / 2 = 1.0. Critical value for a one-sided test with 24 df at 5% is 1.711. Since 1.0 < 1.711, we fail to reject H0. The p-value is about 0.16.
